input: # The adder grammar — `val = add`, `add = NR [ PL add ]` — from the
# @tabnas/parser README. Implemented as a plugin in ts/src/adder.ts and
# go/adder/adder.go, and run against these rows by both runtimes.
# Any number the engine's built-in #NR token lexes is a term.
# Space between tokens is lexed away, so it makes no difference where.
# Escaped whitespace. The loader decodes \t and \n in the input column,
# so these rows pin the escape codec end to end: get the decoding wrong
# in one runtime and that runtime alone stops parsing them.
